svg.aria-label: Remove from a list, in memory. Remove the element at a random index, then push one, so the list keeps its length: one op is both. Nothing touches the disk. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (no list that merges by position); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (needs its storage adapter to answer in Node.js); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
